component.name: LMB (Lightmorphic Browser)
component.summary: Privacy-first browser built on Chromium, hardened against Google

description.p: LMB (Lightmorphic Browser) is a privacy-first browser built on official open-source Chromium (not "Google Chrome"), with background networking, sync, domain reliability, and phishing-detection pings disabled by our own flags — not a third-party de-googling project we'd depend on staying maintained. Sync is end-to-end encrypted — your data is encrypted before it ever leaves your device, so even a compromised sync server can't read it. Self-host your own sync server or use ours. A sidebar panel (notes, pinned pages, bookmarks) and a right-click quick-paste tool for snippets and clipboard history round it out. Extension installs are proxied rather than talking to Google directly.
